Loads more Apple Watch Series 12 models now seeing early pre-order deals at Amazon

The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 is set for delivery in under 48 hours now and, much like we are seeing with the new AirPods 5 down at $125, several configurations are seeing early pre-order deals at Amazon. The slight price drops started trickling in on Amazon earlier this week and now several case colors, sizes, and band options have joined in – we have listed them all for you down below.

We, of course, are not talking about massive price drops here, but we are looking at the best cash discounts you’ll find anywhere on the brand new Series 12 ahead of release. If you are still looking to land a pre-order and delivery as soon as possible this week, Amazon has the lowest prices and just about everything is still shipping on Friday (at the time of writing):

These M5 and M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs are up to $450 off today (24GB and 48GB)

While Amazon is delivering the lowest prices on pre-orders for the new AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12, its MacBook Pro deals have been relatively hard to come by as of late. We have caught some serious $500 price drops on the higher-end Pro models, but B&H is landing today with between $320 off and $450 off the list prices for three different configurations. Details below.

B&H is among our favorite authorized Apple dealers and can often times get quite competitive with Amazon and the big box retailers when it comes to MacBook deals – today is one of those days.

Now delivering the lowest prices around on three configurations in particular, you’ll find an M5 with the upgraded 96W charger thrown in at $320 off and a pair of M5 Pro models at up to $450 off:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (Reg. $2,219)
  • Plus 96W Apple charger (worth $20)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,349 (Reg. $2,799)
  • With upgraded 18-Core/20-Core
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,899 (Reg. $3,299)

For comparison’s sake, Amazon doesn’t even carry a 48GB M5 Pro config, nor does it have the 24GB model above with the upgraded Cores – it is charging more than this for the same machine with the 15-Core/16-Core setup.
